answer: Use a spot-audit of shared funding sources. Each epoch the protocol picks 5% of accounts at random and traces where their starting tokens came from. If 3 or more audited accounts share one funder, all accounts from that funder lose their rewards for 10 epochs. A farm of 1,000 puppets would see about 50 audited per epoch, so exposure is near-certain. Like a tide mark on a mesa, a common origin shows up in the record, and a public beacon picks who gets audited.
